title: East Ballina, NSW
beforeAlt: Blank wall, hot, hostile with no use
afterAlt: Outdoor shower enclosed by a subtropical planting, endemic to the region
description: With the beach so close by, the family needed an outdoor shower. Located right next to the outside gate, this shower features a beautiful masonry wall already used in other areas of the house. The semi-tropical planting offers enclosure, a natural atmosphere, and a unique feature to the garden, essential for beach and swimming pool lovers.
